name: Fathom Dollar
oneLiner: FXD is Fathom Protocol's CDP-minted dollar on XDC; the issuer wound it down in 2026, leaving only pro-rata redemption.
collateral: Overcollateralized XDC and protocol collateral-pool positions in Fathom Protocol
pegMechanism: FXD was minted from overcollateralized CDPs; liquidations and a StableSwap Module supported the peg until the issuer's 2026 wind-down closed the repay-to-close flow

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Fathom's official documentation describes FXD issuance through overcollateralized positions. XDC transaction 0x51177c1b72547a1511a60ca3a5973587f50a83ab44166721cd68b08972eb76e2 created the tracked FXD proxy at block 59804723 on 2023-04-28, establishing the implementation boundary.

obituary.epitaph: Fathom shut down its CDP dollar; the residual token kept trading
obituary.obituary: Fathom's CDP-backed dollar entered shutdown on August 26, 2026, when its documented ShowStopper contract was caged in XDC transaction 0x07a63d9a4f3ad3859b6fff6d35fbe98074980d3bcac8b26f572532d82c67ffc9 at block 106506290. The shutdown disabled ordinary issuance and peg operations; the contract still reports live() = 0 with the same shutdown timestamp. This followed the issuer's recorded August wind-down announcement. FXD remained a residual traded token, with a sparse CoinGecko observation near $0.8423 at the November 8 archive capture. Pharos preserves its market history as a frozen wind-down asset rather than treating residual trading as an operating stablecoin.
